request.style: English, male rock voice with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, organ, anthemic mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
John was arrested, Jesus withdrew
Left Nazareth for the sea
Settled in Capernaum
In Zebulun and Naphtali

[Verse]
Fulfilling the word of Isaiah
The people sat in darkness
Now a great light has been seen
In the land of death's shadow

[Chorus]
Repent, for the kingdom is near
Great light for the nations
Follow me, be fishers of men
Your new calling is here

[Verse]
Walking beside the Sea of Galilee
He saw Simon and Andrew
Casting their nets into the water
He called them to follow

[Chorus]
Repent, for the kingdom is near
Great light for the nations
Follow me, be fishers of men
Your new calling is here

[Bridge]
James and John left their father
In the boat with their nets
At once they followed him
Through all of Galilee

[Verse]
Teaching in the synagogues
Proclaiming the good news
Healing every disease
Among the people there

[Chorus]
Repent, for the kingdom is near
Great light for the nations
Follow me, be fishers of men
Your new calling is here

[Outro]
News spread through all of Syria
Crowds from Judea followed him
